tests.name: DeliverySection Metrics tab offers the Metrics tab to community users without a premium license
DeliverySection Metrics tab renders the burnup chart for community users without a premium license
DeliverySection Metrics tab does not fetch metrics history while the Work Items tab is active
DeliverySection Metrics tab does not render the burnup chart while the Work Items tab is the active one
DeliverySection Metrics tab removes the burnup chart again when returning to the Work Items tab
DeliverySection Metrics tab does not fetch metrics when the active tab is switched to a non-Metrics tab
DeliverySection Metrics tab lazily fetches metrics history for the delivery on the first Metrics-tab open
DeliverySection Metrics tab renders the burnup chart with the fetched history once Metrics is opened
DeliverySection Metrics tab renders the burnup, predictability and fever charts together from the same fetched history
DeliverySection Metrics tab shows a loading placeholder while the metrics history is still in flight
DeliverySection Metrics tab fetches metrics history only once across repeated tab switches
DeliverySection Metrics tab snapshot gating disables the Metrics tab with an explanatory tooltip while too few snapshots are recorded
DeliverySection Metrics tab snapshot gating enables the Metrics tab once enough snapshots are recorded
DeliverySection Metrics tab snapshot gating does not fetch metrics or switch tabs when the disabled Metrics tab is clicked
DeliverySection Metrics tab layout shows the epic size and count card built from the same fetched history (AC-1.3)
DeliverySection Metrics tab layout reads the four cards burnup, predictability, epic size and count, fever (AC-1.3)
DeliverySection Metrics tab layout gives each of the four cards its own cell so none spans the whole row (AC-1.3)
DeliverySection Metrics tab layout pairs the cards on a wide screen and stacks them on a narrow one (AC-1.4)
DeliverySection Metrics tab layout hands the chart this instance's word for epics (AC-1.5)
DeliverySection Metrics tab layout names the card's enlarge control after the same term
DeliverySection Metrics tab layout keeps the placeholder up when the delivery has no metrics to show
DeliveryEpicSizeChart count line plots one point per recorded day whose value is that day's epic count (AC-1.1)
DeliveryEpicSizeChart count line labels each plotted point with the day it was recorded (AC-1.1)
DeliveryEpicSizeChart count line spaces the days evenly rather than by calendar distance (ADR-122)
DeliveryEpicSizeChart count line counts a day's epics from the breakdown recorded on that day (AC-1.6)
DeliveryEpicSizeChart count line draws the count against its own right-hand scale so sizes can share the chart (ADR-122)
DeliveryEpicSizeChart count line draws the count as a line, not as another bar (ADR-122)
DeliveryEpicSizeChart count line picks the count line out against the bars behind it
DeliveryEpicSizeChart count line scales the count from zero so a flat line is not read as a cliff
DeliveryEpicSizeChart count line tells the forecaster the chart builds forward when nothing is recorded yet (AC-1.2)
DeliveryEpicSizeChart count line names the chart after whatever this instance calls its epics (AC-1.5)
DeliveryEpicSizeChart count line still names itself when the caller supplies no term
DeliveryEpicSizeChart count line offers the forecaster the detail behind a day on hover
DeliveryEpicSizeChart size bars gives every epic on a day its own segment, sized by its items (AC-2.5)
DeliveryEpicSizeChart size bars stacks the day's epics into one bar rather than standing them side by side (AC-2.5)
DeliveryEpicSizeChart size bars draws no bar for a day recorded before sizes were written (AC-2.5)
DeliveryEpicSizeChart size bars declares no items scale when there is nothing to size against it
DeliveryEpicSizeChart size bars scales and labels the bars on an items axis of their own
DeliveryEpicSizeChart size bars declares the count scale alone when no day carries a size
DeliveryEpicSizeChart size bars keeps an epic that left the delivery on the days it was there (AC-2.6)
DeliveryEpicSizeChart size bars sizes the bars on their own left-hand scale, apart from the count (ADR-122)
DeliveryEpicSizeChart size bars leaves an epic out of the day's tooltip when it was not in the delivery yet
DeliveryEpicSizeChart size bars colours each segment from the delivery-wide epic palette
DeliveryEpicSizeChart size bars orders the stack by epic so the bars do not reshuffle between days
DeliveryEpicSizeChart estimate hatching hands BarPlot its own bar renderer so a segment can carry a pattern (ADR-119)
DeliveryEpicSizeChart estimate hatching hatches a segment whose size is the portfolio default (AC-3.2)

DeliveryEpicSizeChart estimate hatching shows the day an epic stopped being a guess (AC-3.4)
DeliveryEpicSizeChart estimate hatching says in the tooltip that a hatched size is a default (AC-3.3)

DeliveryEpicSizeChart estimate hatching builds a pattern id that is safe inside url(#...)
DeliveryEpicSizeChart estimate hatching gives each chart on the page its own pattern so two deliveries do not collide (AC-3.6)
